name: openviking-memory
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：openviking-memory。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Recall and persist long-term memory through the OpenViking MCP tools. Use at the start of any substantive task (coding, configuration, debugging, multi-step or tool-based work) to retrieve relevant prior knowledge with find/search/read, and during or after work to persist durable facts, preferences, decisions, and lessons with remember/write. Do not use for casual chat or simple factual questions
unshelve_reason: 问二 · 火山引擎官方仓库里给自家 MCP 服务写的调用说明书，同时是通用记忆件里的第 N 个。正文自己承认没接上那台服务器就整件空转；用户要它自然会去 OpenViking 仓库拿，我们收它给不出任何增量。 正文原话：Use only the tools the session actually registered … If no OpenViking tools are registered at all, continue without memory. Do not fabricate tool calls or fall back to raw HTTP.
